Arbitrary Skepticism: In the beginning of the movie, after managing to escape being sold into slavery as a woman and commanding Sebastian to murder every enemy in the warehouse, she turns to one of the human trafficking victims who has seen everything and is praying with a crucifix in their hands and tells her that there's no point in praying because God doesn't exist and no one will save any one of them…and then walks out of the burning warehouse with herdemonbutler asking her what she would like for dinner. Break the Cutie: She was only seven years old when she watched her parents die and was kidnapped and tortured. Dark and Troubled Past: As a little girl, her parents were murdered and she was kidnapped, tortured and branded. Then she later sells her soul to Sebastian.

characters.name: Rin
characters.description: Rin is Shiori's maid and incredibly similar to Mey-Rin in appearance and personality, possibly implying that she is related to Mey-Rin, just as Shiori is to Ciel. Action Girl:She's a skilled fighter and marksman, being trained by her family to fight for the Genpo/Phantomhive family. Blind Without 'Em: Averted, as Sebastian states that her eyesight is perfectly fine nor the source of her clumsiness.When they come off though… The Reveal:Two. One) that she, like her possible relative, is a skilled fighter and Two) she knew Kiyoharu was Shiori for the past ten years and pieced together when she would come back as a boy. Undying Loyalty: Her family has served the Genpo/Phantomhive family for generations and lives for that exact purpose.She even learned how to fight to defend the family and even though she admits she's a useless maid, Shiori never got rid of her or thought about it so she even prepared to die for Shiori.

characters.name: Hanae Wakatsuki
characters.description: Hanae is Shiori's aunt, her mother's sister, and only remaining relative. She bears heavy similarities to Madame Red. Beauty Is Bad:She and Kujo come across Necrosis while trying to develop a pill to keep her beauty and prolong her aging. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing:Just because Shiori, Rin, and Sebastian got in her way to frame Shinozaki the weapons dealer for the terrorist attack, she decides to frame Shiori and The Queen for it all.She was originally married to Arihito Genpo first and then an accident happened and she lost her child, rendering her barren and Arihito divorced her for it and married her sister, Erika. This made her so angry that she sold both her sister and her ex-husband out to an Eastern syndicate that wanted them dead. She was originally married to Arihito Genpo first and then an accident happened and she lost her child, rendering her barren and Arihito divorced her for it and married her sister, Erika. This made her so angry that she sold both her sister and her ex-husband out to an Eastern syndicate that wanted them dead. Cool Aunt: To Kiyoharu/Shioriat first, anyway. She isn't aware that Kiyoharu is actually Shiori, but even so, supported Kiyoharu as his guardian and with her cooperation, Shiori as Kiyoharu maintained and strengthened the Genpo/Phantomhive family's wealth. She also seems to be aware that Kiyoharu is the Queen's Watchdog.In actuality, she actually knew that Kiyoharu was Shiori from the very beginning and she also knew that Shiori sold her soul to a demon, just like her relatives before her.

characters.name: Charles B. Sato
characters.description: Charles is the Queen of the Western Nations' personal secretary, who often visits Kiyoharu/Shiori. But Not Too Foreign: He seems to be half-English, half-Japanese. Isn't too odd, considering the actor who plays him is actually half-Spanish, half-Japanese.

characters.name: Tokizawa Ichiro
characters.description: An investigator with the Foreign Affairs Bureau for the Ministry of State Security, who believes Shiori/Kiyoharu and Sebastian poses a danger to the Eastern Nations and their citizens as The Queen's Watchdog and wants to eradicate them as soon as possible. Jerkass: He wasn't above calling in a 17 year old and their butler for "interrogation". He just didn't expect to only get Sebastian and he REALLY didn't expect his "interrogation" to go so badly. For him, anyway.

characters.name: Jay the Undertaker
characters.description: A mysterious undertaker who allows Kiyoharu/Shiori to examine bodies for a fee. Ambiguously Evil: He's not evil, but he's definitely not on the side of the good guys.

characters.name: Kujo Shinpei
characters.description: The head of a pharmaceutical corporation.He's also the one responsible for developing Necrosis, the drug behind the serial mummification murders after being commissioned by Hanae Wakatsuki to create a pill that would prolong her life and beauty. Hate Sink:He is a pharmaceutical executive hired byLady Hanae Wakatsukito make an immortality serum. To do so, he buys women fromHuman Traffickersand experiments on them until their bodies give out. After discovering a drug called Necrosis, which mummifies people within minutes, Kujo tests it on various people. This eventually culminates in him poisoning a nightclub full of people and watching them tear each other apart for the antidote. To the Pain:Heoffers up a new drug for the clubgoers called Necrosisand when the first victim starts dying and everyone starts panicking, he gleefully explains that they've just inhaled the drug responsible for The Devil's Curse deaths and begins to explain how they will die as they're doing so. Would Hurt a Child: Well, teenager really.He knocks out Shiori and Rin when they sneak into the secret club. And later it's revealed that while developing Hanae's beauty drug AND Necrosis, he used young women and girls as lab rats and ingredients so it explains where those girls at the beginning of the film would've gone to. You Have Outlived Your Usefulness:He's murdered by Hanae once he gives her everything involving her beauty medication, Necrosis, including the formula and the antidote.
